loops.minute_1: Player bounces ball off paddle, destroys first brick group, score increments, immediate visual feedback. Ball physics begin with base speed.
loops.minute_10: Halfway through first screen cleared. Ball speed increases after 4 hits and 12 hits. Paddle control becomes precise. Player manages angle prediction.
loops.hour_5: Complete first screen, transition to second screen. Paddle shrinks to 50% size. Difficulty escalates noticeably. Score accumulation becomes challenging.
loops.endgame: Destroy all bricks on both screens = VICTORY. Lose 3 lives (ball passes bottom) = DEFEAT. Game halts immediately. Final score = 896 max (single-player).

objectives.victory_condition: Destroy all 96 bricks across two screens before losing 3 balls
objectives.defeat_condition: Ball passes below paddle 3 times (3 lives exhausted)
objectives.player_goal: Maximize score (tiered: Yellow 1pt, Green 3pt, Orange 5pt, Red 7pt) and clear both screens

games.retention_answer: Score is a clear, finite objective (896 max), creating a challenge-focused appeal rather than endless progression. Simple mechanics mask prediction-depth: trajectory angles depend on paddle contact point, forcing skill development. Short runtime (5-15 min) enables rapid retry loops, encouraging mastery-seeking behavior.

loops.minute_1: Paddle responds to input. Break first bricks. Encounter first power-up capsule. Learn visual feedback for capsule type (multi-ball icon, slow-down icon, etc.).
loops.minute_10: Complete 1-2 levels. Adapt paddle to new brick layouts (multi-hit bricks appear). Juggle power-ups strategically (choose which to catch). Refine paddle timing.
loops.hour_5: Progress through 5-8 levels (of 33). Master enemy patterns (floating enemies for bonus points). Recognize that power-up randomness creates volatility. Difficulty escalates per level.
loops.endgame: Reach DOH boss (level 33). Defeat DOH = VICTORY. No continue allowed after running out of lives on final stage = DEFEAT. Game ends regardless.

objectives.defeat_condition: Lose all lives before reaching or defeating DOH
objectives.player_goal: Progress through 33 distinct levels, collect power-ups strategically, defeat the final boss

games.retention_answer: 33 levels provide sustained progression without repetition; each level has distinct brick topology and enemy patterns. Power-up randomness (paddle extend, ball slow, extra life, multi-ball, cannon) creates volatility and re-run incentives—a player might fail level 5 once, then clear it with lucky power-up drops. Boss finale (DOH) provides narrative closure and a final skill-check. Total playtime (30-60 min per run) suits arcade cabinet economy.

loops.minute_1: Aim and fire first orb at peg board. Watch orb bounce and accumulate damage to enemy. Learn peg interaction (green R pegs reset board, yellow ! pegs critical hits). First combat resolved after orb depletes.
loops.minute_10: Complete first enemy encounter. Choose reward (new orb type or relic). Understand synergy potential (e.g., fire orb + chill relic = slow burn). Enter second encounter. Deck-building mindset begins.
loops.hour_5: Traverse 3-4 dungeon floors. Fight escalating enemies. Visit shops and narrative events (non-combat choices). Collect relics and orbs. Build synergistic loadouts. Face mid-run boss. Meta-progression (unlock new orb types) becomes visible.
loops.endgame: Reach final dungeon boss. Defeat final boss = RUN VICTORY + loot unlock. Lose all health before boss = RUN DEFEAT + return to lobby. Cruciball mode (level 20+ difficulty) auto-enables negative effects on re-runs, creating escalating meta-challenge.

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat final dungeon boss while maintaining health > 0
objectives.defeat_condition: Health reaches 0 before defeating final boss
objectives.player_goal: Navigate procedurally-generated dungeon, defeat enemies via orb-peg pachinko, build synergistic orb+relic deck, reach and defeat final boss

games.retention_answer: Roguelike procedural generation ensures no two dungeon maps or enemy sequences repeat, eliminating boredom from static content. Deck-building mechanics tap into theorycrafting (orb synergies, relic interactions, scaling), encouraging min-max behavior and playstyle experimentation. Death → reset to run start creates incremental-progress loops (each attempt unlocks permanent orb types and meta-progression). Cruciball escalation (self-imposed harder modes) extends endgame appeal. Meta-currency (relics, orbs) bridges individual runs into long-term engagement.
